text.p: These are the leading stories in Skopje press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Macedonian government is concerned by the situation in Albania and warns Macedonian citizens not to travel to this neighbouring country. Ministry of foreign affairs demanded Macedonian citizens in Albania to immediately register in the Macedonian embassy in Tirana in order to protect their interests.

- UNPREDEP closed one of its observer posts at the Macedonian-Albanian border at a moment when the crisis in Albania has reached its peak, writes the paper in a commentary. Macedonian foreign ministry to demand prolongation of the UNPREDEP mission in the country.
- Macedonia's biggest rivers Vardar and Bregalnica are almost dead, pollution protection does not function.

- Macedonian students from Teachers' Academy to start hunger strike in the centre of Skopje. The students demand resignation of education minister Sofija Todorova and abolishment of the law on use of national minorities' languages in the academy.
